events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on August 15, 1969, drawing hundreds of thousands to a dairy farm in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock '69
angles.copy: 57 years since the most iconic festival in history kicked off. Imagine being there for Woodstock '69.

events.title: Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the "King of Rock and Roll," passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King today. It's 49 years since Elvis Presley left us, but his music lives on.

events.title: Tupac Shakur's passing
events.blurb: Influential rapper Tupac Shakur died on September 13, 1996, six days after being shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: 30 years since we lost a hip-hop icon. Remembering the groundbreaking artistry of Tupac Shakur today.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's passing
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: The world lost a true guitar hero 56 years ago today. Remembering the incomparable Jimi Hendrix.

events.title: Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road,' on September 26, 1969, featuring iconic tracks and that famous cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Album
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road' – an album and a cover that defined an era. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid is 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher.

events.title: Imagine single anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 24, 1975, becoming a timeless anthem for peace.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: More than just a song, 'Imagine' continues to inspire. Remembering John Lennon's powerful message.

events.title: iPod launch anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the first time you saw an iPod? 25 years since Apple changed the game for portable music.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No,' in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. Happy James Bond Day to all the 007 fans out there! What's your favourite Bond theme?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the extraordinary talent and vision of John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the comedy legend John Cleese! Still making us laugh after all these years.

events.title: White Album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles delivered their sprawling masterpiece, 'The White Album'. A truly groundbreaking record.

events.title: Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Queen's iconic frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled showmanship and voice of Freddie Mercury, 35 years since we lost him.
